title: Duality bound for a mollification tested against admissible C¹ fields (computation of Simon 2.5)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ ℝⁿ open, u integrable on W, and σ ∈ ℝ. Let ρ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be continuous with ρ ≥ 0, support ρ ⊆ B(0,σ) (open ball) and ∫ρ = 1. Let g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ be a C¹ vector field with compact support such that ‖g(x)‖ ≤ 1 for all x and closedBall(y,σ) ⊆ W for every y ∈ tsupport g. Put w := ρ * (1_W u) = convolution ρ (W.indicator u) (lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume. Then ofReal(∫ w(x) div g(x) dx) ≤ |Du|(W) := Chapter02.bvVariationOn u W in [0,∞], where div = Chapter02.euclideanDivergence.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Rn n)) (u ρ : Rn n → ℝ) (σ : ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsOpen W → IntegrableOn u W volume → Continuous ρ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) → Function.support ρ ⊆ ball 0 σ → ∫ x, ρ x = 1 → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ y ∈ tsupport g, closedBall y σ ⊆ W) → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, convolution ρ (W.indicator u) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x) ≤ Chapter02.bvVariationOn u W
